puzzles.title: Active Users with Multiple Orders
puzzles.explanation: CTE identifies users with 5+ orders in 30 days. Main query joins with users table for names. Results sorted by activity level.

puzzles.title: Session Analysis with Nested Subqueries
puzzles.explanation: Find users who performed a purchase between two login events. Uses nested EXISTS to ensure sequence: login -> purchase -> login.

puzzles.title: Employee Hierarchy with Recursive CTE
puzzles.explanation: Recursive CTE builds org chart from top-level managers (manager_id IS NULL) down. STRING_AGG concatenates names at each level.

puzzles.title: First and Last Purchase Analysis
puzzles.explanation: Window functions track user purchase history. FIRST_VALUE gets first purchase, LAST_VALUE with UNBOUNDED gets last. ROW_NUMBER shows sequence.

puzzles.title: Month-over-Month Spend Analysis
puzzles.explanation: Monthly spend with MoM change. EXTRACT gets year/month, LAG compares with previous month, calculates absolute change.

puzzles.title: Daily Conversion Rate with Date Series
puzzles.explanation: Generate complete date range for 30 days. LEFT JOIN ensures zero days are included. CASE inside COUNT creates conditional counts. ROUND calculates conversion percentage.

puzzles.title: Customer Segmentation with NTILE
puzzles.explanation: NTILE divides each user's purchases into 4 tiers. SUM with custom window frame calculates running total in chronological order.

puzzles.title: Salary Band Ranking with CASE
puzzles.explanation: CASE creates salary bands. RANK with PARTITION BY the same CASE ranks employees within each band. Shows relative position within each tier.

puzzles.title: Session Detection with LAG
puzzles.explanation: Session detection algorithm. LAG finds time between views, >30 minutes marks new session. SUM over time assigns session IDs. Count unique sessions per user.

puzzles.title: Year-over-Year Growth Analysis
puzzles.explanation: LAG with offset 12 compares each month with the same month last year. Calculates absolute and percentage change for year-over-year analysis.

puzzles.title: Monthly Customer Ranking
puzzles.explanation: Monthly customer ranking by spending. DENSE_RANK gives position without gaps. PERCENT_RANK shows percentile distribution within each month.

puzzles.title: Purchase Interval Analysis
puzzles.explanation: Self-join finds the immediate next purchase for each order. NOT EXISTS ensures no intervening purchases. Calculates days between purchases.

puzzles.title: Quarterly Growth by Category
puzzles.explanation: CTE aggregates sales by category, year, and quarter. LAG with offset 1 calculates QoQ growth, offset 4 calculates YoY growth. CASE prevents cross-category calculations.

puzzles.title: Customer Profile with Arrays
puzzles.explanation: ARRAY_AGG creates ordered arrays of purchases. ARRAY_LENGTH counts purchases per user. MAX with empty window finds global max for comparison.

puzzles.title: Department Salary Tiers
puzzles.explanation: RANK ranks salaries within departments. CEIL divides department into 3 equal tiers. Great for compensation distribution analysis.

puzzles.title: Cumulative Sales with Window Frames
puzzles.explanation: Three different window frames: UNBOUNDED PRECEDING for cumulative total, 6 PRECEDING for 7-day rolling, 29 PRECEDING for 30-day rolling.

puzzles.title: Product Basket Analysis
puzzles.explanation: ARRAY_AGG creates product lists per basket. ARRAY_LENGTH with DISTINCT counts unique categories. HAVING filters multi-category baskets over $100.

puzzles.title: Pivot Table with CASE
puzzles.explanation: Classic pivot using CASE inside SUM. Each quarter becomes its own column. NULL handling with ELSE 0 ensures zeros for missing quarters.

puzzles.title: Employee Self-Join for Manager Chains
puzzles.explanation: Multiple self-joins to show reporting hierarchy. LEFT JOIN handles employees with no manager (CEO). Shows chain of command up to 3 levels.

puzzles.title: Complex WHERE with IN and Subquery
puzzles.explanation: Two subqueries: first finds departments with avg salary >70k, second is correlated subquery for department-specific avg. Finds high earners in high-paying departments.

puzzles.title: Gaps and Islands Detection
puzzles.explanation: Gaps and islands detection. ROW_NUMBER minus date creates groups of consecutive dates. Finds periods with 4+ consecutive purchases.

puzzles.title: Multi-Level Aggregation with Rollup
puzzles.explanation: ROLLUP generates subtotals at multiple levels: category, category+subcategory, and grand total. COALESCE replaces NULL with 'All' for readability.

puzzles.title: Window Function with Multiple PARTITIONs
puzzles.explanation: Multiple window functions with the same PARTITION BY. Computes monthly order statistics per user without collapsing rows.

puzzles.title: Correlated Subquery for Moving Average
puzzles.explanation: Correlated subquery computes rolling average. For each row, subquery averages sales from the last 7 days including current date.

puzzles.title: Date Dimension Table Creation
puzzles.explanation: Generate a complete date dimension table for 2024. EXTRACT gets various date components. CASE creates weekday/weekend indicator.

puzzles.title: Complex Join with Aggregation
puzzles.explanation: Four-table join with COUNT DISTINCT to avoid duplication. Calculates customer metrics: orders, unique products, total spend, average order value.

puzzles.title: Conditional Aggregation
puzzles.explanation: Conditional aggregation with COUNT and SUM. Multiple CASE expressions create columns for different statuses in one query.

puzzles.title: Recursive CTE for Number Series
puzzles.explanation: Recursive CTE generates numbers 1-100. Then computes square, cube, and parity classification. Simple but powerful pattern.

puzzles.title: Top N Per Group with RANK
puzzles.explanation: RANK gives position within each department. Filter WHERE rank <= 5 gets top 5 earners per department. Handles ties correctly.

puzzles.title: JSON Aggregation in SQL
puzzles.explanation: JSON_AGG with JSON_BUILD_OBJECT creates JSON array of orders per user. ORDER BY inside aggregation controls array ordering.

puzzles.title: Cumulative Distribution Analysis
puzzles.explanation: Three distribution metrics: CUME_DIST (relative position as cumulative), PERCENT_RANK (percentile), NTILE(10) (decile grouping).

puzzles.title: Simple Product Filter
puzzles.explanation: BETWEEN filters products within a price range. AND combines with category filter. Returns Electronics priced $50-200.

puzzles.title: Distinct Customer Cities
puzzles.explanation: DISTINCT removes duplicate cities. WHERE filters for USA customers only. Results alphabetically sorted.

puzzles.title: Products with No Stock
puzzles.explanation: OR combines two conditions: out of stock (0) and unknown stock (NULL). Finds products that cannot be sold.

puzzles.title: Order Total Calculation
puzzles.explanation: Calculates total for each order by multiplying quantity and price, then summing. GROUP BY ensures one row per order.

puzzles.title: Customer Lifetime Value with Cohort
puzzles.explanation: Cohort analysis groups users by their first order month/year. Calculates total revenue and user count per cohort.

puzzles.title: Active Users Today

puzzles.title: Products by Category Count
puzzles.explanation: Counts products per category. ORDER BY DESC shows categories with most products first.

puzzles.title: Cheapest Products

puzzles.title: Users with No Orders
puzzles.explanation: LEFT JOIN returns all users even if no orders. WHERE o.id IS NULL filters to users without orders.

puzzles.title: Consecutive Login Days

puzzles.title: Employees by Department

puzzles.title: Monthly Active Users

puzzles.title: High Value Customers

puzzles.title: Available Products
